subject: RE: FW: AMSTERDAM SCHIPHOL - PVG / 138 CTN 4,945 KGS
body:
Hi,

I’m arranging the flight for our buyer’s import from Germany. Could you quote the cheapest air freight option from Frankfurt (FRA) to Johannesburg (JNB), with an all-in price in EUR?

The import shipment is 1 piece of furniture samples, 964 kg gross and 6.87 cbm. It’s ready on 2026-11-27, and we’ll deliver it to FRA ourselves.

Sara
Lindqvist Medtech
